description: Land Acquisition - Pattivila, Biyagama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1903/57 of 27.02.2015
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains two separate notices under Section 7 of the Act, both concerning the government's acquisition of specific lands for public purposes, including descriptions of the lands to be acquired, extent measurements, location details, and procedures for title claims and compensation inquiries. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land acquisition, property ownership transfers, and related administrative procedures.
